messages:
Sam (sales): Hey team — NexaHealth POC kickoff tomorrow. They asked for a short walkthrough of privacy controls + SIG/CAIQ answers before we start. Main asks: DPA language, SCCs applicability, DSAR/deletion flow, and whether customer data remains in their VPC for Dedicated. Can we align quickly? :hourglass:

Priya (security): I can take SIG/CAIQ answers. For SCCs we need to confirm data residency — if Hosted in EU region, SCCs apply. Also need to confirm whether we flow PSN or PHI into logs. Any demo data or real PHI? :question:

Ethan (solutions): POC will use demo data sanitized, but NexaHealth wants to test a small set of real de-identified patient metadata. We'll run it in a dedicated tenant on staging. I can provide network diagram. Will need deletion API and audit logs.

Mallory (legal): For DPA: we can propose clause: 'Processor shall delete or return personal data upon Controller request within 30 days, except as required to retain for legal obligations.' Want to keep 30 days; customer asked 7 days — is that feasible operationally? :thinking_face:

Sam (sales): They pushed for 7 days for DSAR completions and deletion window. If we can't do 7, can we offer 7 for POC and 30 for production?

Priya (security): 7-day delete SLA is tight for cross-region backups. We can offer 7-day soft-delete (logical) + 30-day physical purge. Suggest we document soft-delete API and schedule for permanent purge. Also need to confirm KMS key ownership for Private.

Ethan (solutions): Implementation sketch for deletion (for POC):
```
DELETE /v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/data?scope=all
Authorization: Bearer <admin_token>
Response: 202 Accepted
Payload: {"job_id":"abc123"}
```
We can surface job status at /v1/jobs/{job_id}. Soft-delete toggles and immediate access removal. Physical purge runs daily.

Priya (security): I'll fill SIG/CAIQ answers and flag the backup retention question under control CC-03. Also will attach CAIQ export and cert checklist. Need contact for KMS/HSM questions — @Mallory?

Mallory (legal): KMS ownership: for Private we can support customer-managed keys (bring-your-own). For Hosted, we use Redwood-managed KMS but offer key segregation at enterprise tier. I'll draft DPA addendum language for the 7 vs 30 negotiation.

risk-bot: New vendor-risk ticket created: VENDOR-4721. Attachments requested: SOC2 report, encryption at rest docs, network diagram. Due: in 48h. Link: https://risks.redwood.internal/tickets/VENDOR-4721 :robot_face:

Sam (sales): I'll message NexaHealth and propose: (1) 7-day soft-delete for POC + job-based physical purge within 30 days, (2) KMS options, (3) SIG/CAIQ export and SOC2. Will share draft DPA. ETA to customer: EOD today. :thumbsup:

Ethan (solutions): I'll drop the staging network diagram and the deletion API demo token in the POC repo: https://git.redwood/repo/nexa-poc (private).

Priya (security): Quick note — for SCCs: if controller is EU-based and we process in non-EU, need SCCs or transfers via Binding Corporate Rules. I'll add a short note in the SIG answers.

Mallory (legal): Approve sending draft DPA addendum; cc: compliance@redwood. If Nexa pushes 7-day for production, escalate to CISO.

Sam (sales): Thanks all — I'll send draft and loop back here with customer's reply. If any blockers, tag me. :rocket:
